# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the CSV file's first column which is an index
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length1_8/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length1_8/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Perform the join on 'track_id' as specified

# Ensure the columns are in the target schema order: ['index_track', 'track_id', 'dummy']

# Cast columns to integer as per target schema

# Write the result to the target path without the index column
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_8/target_multisource.csv"
df_result.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
